title: Consistent Pottery Sherds
description: Makes Pottery Sherds be consistent with Banner Patterns
body:
## Summary

Removes the patterns from the pottery sherd items so it will be consistent with banner patterns, just as mojang intended!

This is obviously a joke pack, which is less funny now that thankfully banners in vanilla arent like this anymore.
